pairs.why: The two navy safes are almost identical; A has slightly crisper edge highlights that come a little closer to the clean, lightly glossy finish of the real cards.
The two are nearly the same; A's blue is a touch brighter and its body edges are a little crisper, which is slightly nearer the saturated royal blue of the vending machine.
B uses a brighter, more saturated royal blue with soft, even shine that matches the real vending machine and sneakers, while A stays dull navy.
A has the brighter, saturated royal blue and clean, smooth shine of the real cards; B is the darker, flatter navy.
Both are dark navy and almost identical; A's slightly lighter body and clearer edge highlights read a little closer to the real cards.
Both safes have the same navy color, shape, gold hardware and finish, so neither is meaningfully closer to the real cards.
